hymns.title: Abide with Me
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Abide with me fast falls the even tide
The darkness deepens Lord with me abide
When other helpers fail and comforts flee
Help of the helpless O abide with me

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Swift to its close ebbs out  life’s little day
Earth’s joys grow dim its glories pass away
Change and decay in all around I see
O Thou who changest not abide with me

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I need Thy presence every passing hour
What but Thy grace can foil the tempters power?
Who like thyself my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine O abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I fear no foe with Thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness.
Where is death’s sting? Where grave Thy victory?
I triumph still if Thou abide with me

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Hold Thou Thy cross before my closing eyes;
Shine through the gloom and point me to the skies
Heaven’s morning breaks and breaths’ vain shadow flee
In life in death O Lord abide with me

hymns.title: Aka Mara Mma Ka Na Enye
Alas! Did My Saviour Bleed
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Alas! And did my saviour bleed?
And did my Sov’reign die?
Would He devote that sacred head
For such a one as I?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
At the cross, at the cross
Where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away (rolled away),
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Was it for crimes that I have done
He groaned upon the tree?
Amazing pity! Grace unknown!
And love beyond degree!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Well might the sun in darkness hide,
And shut His glories in,
When Christ, the mighty Maker, died
For Man, the creature’s sin.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Thus might I hide my blushing face
While His dear cross appears;
Dissolve my heart in thankfulness,
And melt mine eyes to tears.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
But drops of grief can ne’er repay
The debt of love I owe:
Here, Lord, I give myself away,
’Tis all that I can do!

hymns.title: All Hail the Power
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
All hail the pow’r of Jesus’ name!
Let angels prostrate fall! (X2)
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him Lord of all;

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Ye chosen seed of Israel’s race,
Ye ransomed from the fall, (X2)
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Let ev’ry kindred, ev’ry tribe,
On this terrestrial ball, (X2)
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall! (X2)
We’ll join the everlasting song,
And praise Him Lord of all.

hymns.title: All Over the World
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
All over the world the spirit is moving,
All over world as the prophets said it would be,
All over the world
There’s a mighty revelation
Of the glory of the Lord
As the waters cover the sea.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Deep down in my heart the spirit is moving,
Deep down in my heart, as the prophets
said it should be.
Deep down in my heart, there is a mighty revelation,
Of the glory of the Lord as the waters covers the sea.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text: All over our church...

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text: All over our lives...

hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
All over the world the spirit is moving,
All over world as the prophets said it would be,
All over the world
There’s a mighty revelation
Of the glory of the Lord
As the waters cover the sea.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Deep down in my heart the spirit is moving,
Deep down in my heart, as the prophets
said it should be.
Deep down in my heart, there is a mighty revelation,
Of the glory of the Lord as the waters covers the sea.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text: All over our church...

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text: All over our lives...

hymns.title: All Things Bright and Beautiful
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
CHORUS
All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful:
The Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Each little flower that opens,
Each little bird that sings,
He made their glowing colours,
He made their tiny wings.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
The purple headed ,mountain,
The river running by,
The sunset, and the morning
That brightens up the sky,

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
The cold wind in the winter,
The pleasant summer sun,
The ripe fruits in the garden:
He made them everyone.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
He gave us eyes to see them,
And lips that we might tell
How great is God Almighty,
Who has made all things well.

hymns.title: All to Jesus I Surrender
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
All to Jesus I surrender,
All to him I freely give;
I will ever love and trust him,
In His presence daily live.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
I surrender all, ( I surrender all;)
I surrender all ( I surrender all;)
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Humbly at His feet I bow;
Worldly pleasures all forsaken,
Take me, Jesus, take me now.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
All to Jesus I surrender,
Lord I give myself to Thee;
Fill me with Thy love and power,
Let Thy blessing fall on me.

hymns.title: Alleluia, Sing to Jesus
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Alleluia, sing to Jesus!
His the scripture, His the throne;
Alleluia His the triumph,
His the victory alone.
Hark the songs of peaceful Zion
Thunder like a mighty flood;
Jesus out of every nation.
Hath redeemed us by his blood.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Alleluia, bread of angels,
Thou on earth our food, our stay:
Alleluia! here the sinful
Flee to Thee from day to day:
Intercessor, friend of sinners,
Earth’s Redeemer, plead for me,
Where the songs of the sinless.
Sweep across the crystal sea.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Alleluia! King eternal,
Thee the Lord of lords we own;
Alleluia! Born of Mary,
Earth Thy footstool, heaven Thy throne:
Thou within the veil hast entered,
Robed in flesh, our great High Priest.
Thou on earth both priest and victim.
In the Eucharistic Feast.

hymns.title: Always Triumphant
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O Lord, Almighty King, praise and honour we shall sing;
When in battle we’ll  be solders of victory!(x2)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
People throughout the world
Live condemned by Satan’s pow’r,
Jesus prevailed at the cross
And brought us to this hour.
Now our world must be won in this generation.
Then Your church will be triumphant,
(Always) triumphant, (Always) triumphant,  O king!
Triumphant (Always), triumphant, O king! (O king!)

sections.label: Verse 3

hymns.title: Am So Glad That Jesus Loves Me
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I am so glad that our Father in Heaven
Tells of his love in the Book He has given
Wonderful things in the Bible I see;
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me,
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Though I forget Him and wonder away,
Still He doth love me whenever I stray,
Back to His dear loving arms would I flee,
When I remember that Jesus loves me.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Oh, if there's only one song I can sing,
When in His beauty I see the great King,
This shall my song in Eternity be,
Oh what a wonder that Jesus loves me.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Jesus loves me and I know I love Him,
Love brought Him down my poor soul to redeem,
Yes, it was love made Him die on the tree,
Oh I am certain that Jesus loves me.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
If one should ask me how can I tell,
Glory, to Jesus, I know very well,
God's Holy Spirit with mine doth agree,
Constantly witnessing - Jesus loves me.

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.text:
In His assurance I find sweetest rest,
Trusting in Jesus, I know I am blest,
Satan, dismayed, from my soul now doth flee,
When  I just tell him that Jesus loves me.

hymns.title: Amara Baba Uba Na Ebe Anyi Nno
Amazing Grace
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Amazing grace how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lost, but now am found
Was blind, but now I see.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
’Twas grace that taught my heart to fear
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Thro’ many dangers, toils and snares
I have already come;
‘This grace has brought me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.text:
And when this flesh and heart shall fail
And mortal life shall cease;
I shall possess within the veil
A life of joy and peace.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
When we’ve been there ten thousand years,
Bright shining as the sun,
We’ve no less days to sing God’s praise
Than when we first begun.

hymns.title: Amen
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Amen  Amen
Amen  Amen Amen.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
See the little baby,
Lying in the manger,
Early in the morning.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
See Him in the temple,
Talking to the elders,
How they marvel at His wisdom.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
See Him at the seaside,
Preaching and healing,
To the blind and feeble.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
See Him in the garden
Praying to His Father,
In deepest sorrow.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
See Him there with Pilate
And Pilate gave a choice.
But they wanted Barabbas.

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.text:
See Him bear His cross now,
Up to Calvary,
Where they crucified my lord.

sections.label: Verse 8
sections.text:
See the empty tomb now,
Christ has arisen!
And He lives with us today!

hymns.title: Angels From the Realms
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Angels, from the realms of glory,
Wing your flight o’er all the earth;
Ye who sang creation’s story,
Now proclaim Messiah’s birth:
Come and worship,
Worship Christ, the new-born King.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Shepherds, in the field abiding,
Watching o’er your flocks by night,
God with man is now residing,
Yonder shines the infant Light:
Come and worship. etc.

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.text:
Saints before the altar bending,
Watching long in hope and fear,
Suddenly the Lord, descending,
In His temple shall appear:
Come and worship, etc.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Though an Infant now we view Him,
He shall fill His Father’s throne,
Gather all the nations to Him;
Every knee shall then bow down:
Come and worship

hymns.title: Angels We Have Heard
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Angels we have heard on high
Sweetly singing o’er the plains,
And the mountains in reply
echoing their joyous strains.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Gloria in excelsis Deo,
Gloria in excelsis Deo.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Shepherds, why this jubilee?
Why your joyous strains prolong
What the gladsome tidings be
Which inspire your heavenly song?

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Come to Bethlehem and see
Him whose birth the angels sing
Come, adore on bended knee
Christ the Lord, the new-born King

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
See Him in a manger laid,
Whose the choirs of angels praise
Mary, Joseph, lend your aid,
While our hearts in love we raise.

hymns.title: As Many as Possible
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Though we are free from all men,
(We choose to) we choose to be slaves again,
To win all possible, as many as possible,
(Possible, as many as possible,)
For Jesus Christ has won!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Lift high the cross to every man,
(On Jesus) on Jesus word take your stand,
To win all possible, as many as possible
(Possible, as many as possible,)
For Jesus Christ has won!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Ev’ry nation is pleading,
Crying out for an answer,
Men of courage must rise up again;
Where are the mighty men?
The kingdom now is at hand,
(And so we) we must become slaves again,
To win all possible, as many as possible
(Possible, as many as possible)

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
For Jesus Christ, (the) the Lord of lords,
(the) the King of kings has won!

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
(Men)
Jesus Christ, Lord of lords,
King of kings, Christ our Lord has won!

hymns.title: As the Deer
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
As the deer pants for the water,
So my soul longs after you.
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship you.
You alone are my strength, my shield,
To you alone may my spirit yield.
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship you.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I want you, more than gold or silver,
Only you can satisfy,
You alone are real joy giver,
And the apple of my eye.
You alone are my strength, my shield,
To you alone may my spirit yield.
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship you.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
You are my friend and you are my brother
Even though you are my King.
I love you more than any other
So much more than anything
You alone are my strength, my shield,
To you alone may my spirit yield.
You alone are my heart's desire
And I long to worship you.

hymns.title: As with Gladness of Old Men
Asafo, Asafo Yehowa Ne Yen Woho
At the Foot of the Cross
Away in a Manger
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
The little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head.
The stars in the bright sky looked down where He lay,
The little Lord Jesus, a sleep on the hay

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
The cattle are lowing, the baby awakes,
But little Lord Jesus, no crying He makes
I love Thee, Lord Jesus look down from the sky
And stay by my cradle till morning is nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Be near me, Lord Jesus, I ask Thee to stay
Close by me forever and love me, I pray
Bless all the dear children in Thy tender care,
And fit us for heaven to live with Thee there.

hymns.title: Be Still My Soul
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.text:
Be still my soul, the hour is hastening on
when we shall be forever with the Lord.
When disappointment, grief and fear are gone;
Sorrow forgot, love’s purest joys restored.
Be still my soul, when change and tears are past,
all safe and blessed we shall meet at last.

hymns.title: Blessed Assurance
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Blessed assurance. Jesus is mine!
O what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation. Purchase of God.
Born of His spirit, washed in His blood.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
This is my story, this is my song.
Praising my saviour all the day long
This is my story, this is my song.
Praising my saviour all the day long

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Perfect submission, perfect delight,
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight:
Angels descending bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Perfect submission, all is at rest:
I in my saviour am happy and blest:
Watching and waiting, looking above:
Filled with His goodness, lost in His love

hymns.title: Blest Be the Tie That Binds
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Blest be the tie that binds,
Our hearts in Christian love;
The fellowship of kindred minds
Is like to that above.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Before our father’s throne,
We pour our ardent prayers;
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one,
Our comforts and our cares

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.text:
When we asunder part,
It gives us inward pain;
But we shall still be joined in heart,
And hope to meet again

sections.label: Verse 5
Verse 6

hymns.title: Blue Skies and Rainbow
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Jesus is well and alive today;
He makes His home in my heart.
Never more will I be all alone since He
Promised me that we never would part.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Green grass and flowers
All blooming in springtime,
Are works of the master I live
for each day.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Tall mountains, green valleys,
The beauty surrounds me,
All make me aware of the one who
made it all.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
I’m not ashamed of
The gospel of Jesus
For it is the power
Of salvation for me.

hymns.title: Breathe on Me, Breath of God
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Fill me with life a new,
That I may love what Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Breathe on me, breath of God
Until my heart is pure,
Until with Thee I will one will,
To do and to endure.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Till I am wholly Thine,
Till all this earthly part of me
Glows with Thy fire divine.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Breathe on me, breath of God,
So shall I never die, but live with Thee
The perfect life of Thine eternity.

hymns.title: Christ, The Lord, Is Risen Today
Christ, We Do All Adore Thee
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Christ, we do all adore Thee,
And we do praise Thee forever
Christ, we do all adore Thee,
And we do praise Thee forever

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
For on the holy cross hast Thou
The world from sin redeemed;
Christ, we do all adore Thee,
And we do praise Thee forever:
Christ, we do all adore Thee!

hymns.title: Come Thou Almighty King
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Come, Thou almighty King
Help us Thy name to sing,
Help us to praise!
Father all glorious,
O’er all victorious,
Come and reign over us,
Ancient of days.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Come, Thou incarnate Word,
Gird on Thy mighty sword,
Our prayer attend;
Come and Thy people bless,
And give Thy Word success;
Spirit of holiness,
On us descend!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Come, holy Comforter,
Thy sacred witness bear,
In this glad hour:
Thou who almighty art,
Now rule in every heart,
And ne’er from us depart,
Spirit of power!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
O Lord, our God to Thee
The highest praises be,
Hence, evermore;
Thy sov’reign majesty
May we in glory see,
And to eternity
Love and adore!

hymns.title: Count Your Blessings
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
When upon life’s billows you are tempest tossed,
When you are discouraged, thinking all is lost,
Count your many blessings name them one by one,
And it will surprise you what the Lord hath done.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.text:
Are you ever burdened with a load of care?
Does the cross seem heavy you are called to bear?
Count your many blessings, every doubt will fly,
And you will keep singing as the days go by.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
When you look at others with their lands and gold,
Think that Christ has promised you His wealth untold;
Count your many blessings;  wealth can never buy.
Your reward in heaven, nor your home on high.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
So, amid the conflict, whether great or small,
Do not be disheartened, God is over all;
Count your many blessings, angels will attend,
Help and comfort give you to your journey’s end.

hymns.title: Create in Me a Pure Heart
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Create in me (create) a pure heart God;
Renew a stead fast (renew) spirit in me.
O do not cast me from Your presence,
Or take your Holy Spirit from me.
Restore to me the joy of Your salvation,
And up hold me with a willing spirit:
Then I will teach transgressors Your ways,
That they’d turn back to you;
And my lips will sing of your salvation!

hymns.title: Crown Him with Many Crowns
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Crown  Him many crowns
The Lamb upon His throne
Hark, how the heav’nly anthem drowns
And music but its own
Awake my soul and sing
Of Him who died for Thee
And hail Him as Thy matchless King
Thro’ all eternity.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Crown Him the Lord of life
Who triumphed o’er the grave
Who rose victorious in the strife
For these He came to save
His glories new we sing
Who died and rose on high
Who died eternal life to bring
And lives that death may die

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Crown Him the Lord of Peace
Whose pow’r a sceptre sways
From pole to pole that wars may cease
Absorbed in prayer and praise
His reign shall know no end
And round His pierced feet
Fair flow’rs of paradise extend
Their fragrance ever sweet

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Crown Him the Lord of heav’n
One with the Father know
And the blest Spirit, thro’ Him giv’n
From yonder glorious throne!
All hail, Redeemer, hail!
For Thou hast died for me
Thy praise and glory shall not fail
Thro’out eternity.

hymns.title: Dear Lord and Father of Mankind
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Dear Lord and Father of mankind,
Forgive our foolish ways:
Reclothe us in our rightful mind,
In purer lives Thy service find,
In deeper reverence praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
In simple trust like theirs who heard,
Beside the Syrian sea,
The gracious calling of the Lord,
Let us, like them, without a word,
Rise up and follow Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
O Sabbath rest by Galilee,
O calm of hills above,
Where Jesus knelt to share with Thee.
The silence of eternity,
Interpreted by love.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Drop Thy still dews of quietness,
Till all our strivings cease:
Take from our souls the strain and stress,
And let our ordered lives confess,
The beauty of Thy peace.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Breath through the hearts of our desire,
Thy coolness and Thy balm:
Let sense be dumb, let flesh retire:
Speak through the earthquake, wind and fire,
O still small voice of calm!

hymns.title: Deep Down in My Heart
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I want to be like Jesus,
Deep down in my heart.
I want to be like Jesus,
Deep down in my heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Singin’ deep deep , singin’ down down,

hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.text:
Don’t you wanna go to the land? (X3)
Where I’m bound, where I’m bound?
Don’t you want to go to that land? (X3)
where I’m bound, where I’m bound?

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Nothing but love in that land...
Nothing but joy in that land...
Nothing but peace in that land...
I’ve got a saviour in that land...

hymns.title: Draw Me Nearer
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I am Thine O Lord I have heard they voice
And it told Thy love me.
But I long to rise in the arms of faith,
And be closer drawn to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS:
Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord
To the cross where Thou hast died,
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, Blessed Lord.
To Thy precious Bleeding side.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Consecrate me now to Thy service Lord
By the power of Grace Divine,
Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope
And my will be lost in Thine.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Oh, the pure delight of a single hour
That before Thy throne I spend
When I kneel in prayer and with Thee my God
I commune as friend with friend.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
There are depths of love that I cannot know.
Till I cross the narrow sea,
There are heights of joy that I may not reach.
Till I rest in peace with Thee.

hymns.title: E, E, E Wewoo-- Wewoo ---Eee Wewo
Fairest Lord Jesus
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Fairest Lord Jesus!
Ruler of all nature!
O Thou of God and man the Son!
Thee will I cherish, Thee will I honour
Thou, my soul’s glory, joy and crown.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Fair are the meadows,
fairer still the woodlands
Robed in the blooming garb of spring:
Jesus is fairer, Jesus is purer,
Who makes the woeful heart to sing.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Fair is the sunshine, fairer still
the moonlight
And all the twinkling starry host
Jesus shines brighter,
Jesus shines purer
Than all the angels heav’n can boast

hymns.title: Father I Adore You
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Father I adore you,
And I lay my life before you,
How I love you.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
(Jesus I adore you)
(Spirit I adore you)

hymns.title: Follow Me
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I travelled down a lonely road, and no one seemed to care
The burden on my weary back had bowed me to despair,
I oft complained to Jesus how folks were treating me,
And then I heard Him say so tenderly,
“My feet were also weary, upon that Calv’ry road,
The cross became so heavy, I fell beneath the load,
Be faithful weary pilgrim the morning I can see,
Just lift your cross and follow close to me.”

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
“I work so hard for Jesus,” I often boast and say.
“I’ve sacrificed a lot of things to walk the narrow way;
I gave up fame and fortune; I’m worth a lot to Thee,”
And then I hear Him gently say to me,
“I left the throne of glory and counted it but loss,
My hands were nailed in anger upon a cruel cross
But now we’ll  make the journey with your hand safe in mine,
So lift your cross and follow close to me.”

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Oh Jesus if I die upon, a foreign field some day
’Twould be no more than love demands no less could I repay
No greater love hath mortal man than for a friend to die
There are the words He gently spoke to me
“If just a cup of water I place within your hand
Then just a cup of water is all that I demand,”
But if by death to living they can Thy glory see,
I’ll take my cross and follow close to Thee.

hymns.title: For Those Tears I Died
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
You said You’d come and share all my sorrows.
You said You’d be there for all my tomorrows.
I came so close to sending You away,
But just like You promised
You came here to stay,
I just had to pray.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
And Jesus said,
“Come to the water, stand by my side.
I know you are thirsty,
You won’t be denied.
I felt every tear drop
When in darkness you cried,
And I strove to remind you
That for those tears I died.”

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Your goodness so great
I can’t understand.
And dear Lord, I know
That all this was planned.
I know You’re here now, and always will be.
Your love loosed my chains
And in You I’m free.
But Jesus, why me?

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Jesus, I give You
My heart and my soul.
I know that without God
I’d never be whole.
Saviour, You opened
All the right doors
And I thank You, and praise You
From earth’s humble shores.
Take me I’m Yours.

hymns.title: For We Are One
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
CHORUS
For we are one in the love of Christ,
If we die with him we will rise up to life.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
If in your life love abounds,
Seek no further for God is found,

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Oh when your brother cries out tears,
Share with him hopes and fears.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Oh when great joy fills your heart,
Open up a smile will start.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Share all your goods with your fellow man,
Walk together hand in hand.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
His body we eat, his blood we drink,
Of the bread of love we eat heartily.

hymns.title: Glorious Things of Thee Are Spoken
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Glorious things of Thee are spoken,
Zion, city of our God!
He whose word cannot be broken
Formed Thee for His own abode,
On the Rock of ages founded,
What can shake Thy sure repose?
With salvation’s walls surrounded
Thou may’st smile at all Thy foes.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
See, the streams of living waters,
Springing from eternal love,
Well supply Thy sons and daughters,
And all fear of want remove:
Who can faint while such a river
Ever flows their thirst t’assuage?
Grace, which, like the Lord the giver,
Never fails from age to age.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Saviour, since of Zion’s city
I, thro’ grace a member am,
Let the world deride or pity,
I will glory in Thy name.
Fading is the worldling’s pleasure,
All His boasted pomp and show;
Solid joys and lasting treasure
None but Zion’s children know.

hymns.title: Glory Be to Jesus
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Glory be to Jesus,
Who in bitter pains
Poured for me the life blood
From His sacred veins

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Grace and life eternal
In the blood I find;
Blest be His compassion,
Infinitely kind.

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.text:
Oft as it is sprinkled;
On our guilty hearts
Satan in confusion,
Terror struck departs.

sections.label: Verse 5

hymns.title: Glory, Glory
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Glory, Glory, Hallelujah,
Since I laid my burden down (way on down) (2x)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I feel better, so much better,
Since I laid my burden down (Way on down) (2x)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text: Friends don’t treat me, like they used to...

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text: I don’t go to places, where I used to...

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text: I don’t cause the strife, that I used to...

hymns.title: Go
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Go ye therefore and teach all nations, go, go, go.
Go ye therefore and teach all nations, go, go, go.
Baptising them in the name of the Father
And Son, and Holy Ghost.
Go, go, go.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
If you love me, really love Me, feed My sheep.
If you love me, really love Me, feed my sheep.
Lo I’ll be with you for ever and ever,
Until the end of the world.
Go, go, go.

hymns.title: Go Make Disciples
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
“Go make of all disciples.” We hear the call, O Lord
That comes from Thee, our Father, In Thy eternal Word.
Inspire our ways of learning through earnest, fervent prayer,
And let our daily living Reveal Thee every where.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
“Go make of all disciples.” Baptising in the name
Of Father, Son, and Spirit From age to age the same.
We call each new disciple To Follow Thee, O Lord,
Redeeming soul and body By water and the Word.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
“Go make of all disciples.” We at Thy feet would stay,
Until each life’s vocation Accents Thy holy way.
We cultivate the nature God plants in every heart,
Revealing in our witness the master teaches art.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
“Go make of all disciples.” We welcome Thy command.
“Lo, I am with you always”  We take Thy guiding hand.
The task looms large before us;  We follow without fear.
In heaven and earth Thy power Shall bring God’s kingdom here.
Amen.

hymns.title: God Is So Good
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
(Men)
God is so good (3x)

sections.text:

Hallelujah (3x)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
CHORUS
He is so good, He is so good to me

sections.text:
Jesus is real...
God answers prayers...

sections.text:
God is so good
Jesus is real
God answers prayers

hymns.title: God Moves in a Mysterious Way
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
God moves in a mysterious way,
His wonders to perform;
He plants his footsteps in the sea,
And rides up on the storm.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Deep in unfathomable mines
Of never failing skill,
He treasures up his bright designs,
And works his gracious will.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Ye fearful saints, fresh courage take,
The clouds ye so much dread
Are big with mercy, and shall break
In blessings on your head.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
His purposes will ripen fast
Unfolding every hour:
The bud may have a bitter taste,
But sweet will be the flow’r.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Blind unbelief is sure to err,
And scan his work in vain;
God is his own interpreter,
And he will make it plain.

hymns.title: God of Mercy and Compassion
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
God of mercy and compassion
Look with pity upon me
Father let me call Thee Father
’Tis Thy child returns to Thee

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Jesus Lord. I ask for mercy
Let me not implore vain
All my sin I now detest them
Never will I sin again

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
By my sins I have deserved
Death and endless misery
Hell with all its pains and torments
And for all eternity.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
By my sins I have abandoned
Right and claim to heaven above
Where the saints rejoice forever
In a boundless sea of love

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
See our Saviour bleeding dying
On the Cross of Calvary
To that cross my sins have nailed Him
Yet He bleeds and died for me

hymns.title: God of Our Fathers
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
God of our fathers, whose almighty hand
Leads forth in beauty all the starry band
Of shinning worlds in splendour through the skies,
Our grateful songs before Thy throne a rise.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

hymns.title: Great Is Thy Faithfulness
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Great is Thy faithfulness, O God my Father,
There is no shadow of turning with Thee,
Thou changest not, Thy compassions they fail not;
As Thou hast been Thou forever wilt be.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS:
Great is Thy faithfulness (2x)
Morning by morning new mercies I see;
All that I needed Thy hand hath provided,
Great is Thy faithfulness,
Lord unto me

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Summer and winter, and spring time and harvest,
Sun, moon, and stars in their courses above
Join with all nature in manifold witness
To Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth,
Thy own dear presence to cheer and to guide;
Strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow,
Blessings are mine, with ten thousand beside!

hymns.title: Guide Me O Thou Great Redeemer
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Guide me O Thou great Redeemer
Pilgrim through this barren land
I am weak but Thou art mighty
Hold me with Thy powerful hand
Bread of heaven(2x)
Feed me now and ever more (2x)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Open now the crystal fountain
Where the healing stream doth flow
Let the fiery cloudy pillar
Lead me all my journey through
Strong deliverer (x2)
Be Thou still my strength and shield(2x)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
When I tread the verge of Jordan
Bid my anxious fears subside
Death of death and hell’s destruction
Land me safe on Canaan’s side
Songs of praises(2x)
I will ever give to Thee(2x)

hymns.title: HAIL JESUS (Victory Chant)
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Hail Jesus, you're my king
Your Life frees me to sing
I will praise you all my days
You're perfect in all your ways

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Hail Jesus, you're my Lord,
I will obey your word
Want to see your kingdom come
Not my will but yours be done

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Hail, hail Lion of Judah
How wonderful you are.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Glory, glory to the Lamb
You take me into the Land
We will conquer in your name
And proclaim that Jesus reigns

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Hail, hail Lion of Judah
How powerful you are

hymns.title: Hallelujah
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Lord we sing your praises loud Sing them to the stumbling crowd Sing of Jesus and His Word Sing until the earth has heard  CHORUS Women: Hallelujah Hallelu Hallelu - lelujah (x2) Men:
Hallelujah Hallelujah

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Sing of crosses and His blood
Earthquakes, darkness and the flood
Sing of judgement, sing of grace
Sing until we see His face

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
God is why we live and sing
We the servants, He the king
All His power, all His life
Living in the church, His wife

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
God is justice, God is love
God is in the morning dove
God is sov'reign o'er the land
Nations bow at His command

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Life is but a passing glance
Seek Him while you have the chance
We are made of naught but clay
Till we're changed on that great day

hymns.title: Hallelujah! Praise Jehova!
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Let them praises give Jehovah,
For his name alone is high,
And his glory is exalted, (4x)
Far above the earth and sky.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Let them praises give Jehovah!
They were made at his command;
Them forever he established:
His decree shall ever stand.
From the earth, O praise Jehovah,
All ye floods, ye dragons all,
Fire and hail and snow and vapours
Stormy winds that hear him call.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
All ye fruit trees and cedars,
All ye hills and mountains high,
Creeping things and beasts and cattle,
Birds that in the heavens fly,
Kings of earth, and all ye people,
Princes great judges all:
Praise his name, young men and maidens,
Aged men and children small.

hymns.title: Hallelujah! What a Saviour!
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
“Man of sorrows” what a name
For the son of God who came
Ruined sinners to reclaim!
Hallelujah! What a Saviour!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Bearing shame and scoffing rude,
In my place condemned he stood
Sealed my pardon with his blood:
Hallelujah! What a Saviour!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Guilty vile and helpless we,
Spotless Lamb of God was he;
Full atonement! can it be?
Hallelujah! What a Saviour !

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Lifted up was he to die,
“It is finished” was his cry;
Now in heav’n exalted high:
Hallelujah What a  Saviour!

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
When he comes, our glorious King,
All his ransomed home to bring,
Then anew this song we’ll sing:
Hallelujah what a Saviour!

hymns.title: Hallelujah, My Father
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.text:
Hallelujah my Jesus, for dying on the tree,
thro’ sad tears you’re looking down
And  I know that you see me,
Trying to live my way
And not the way you would,
Hallelujah, my Jesus in your dying is my birth
Hallelujah, my Jesus you’re the light of the earth.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Hallelujah, great Spirit, for living in my heart,
I now know that your word is true,
From you I will not depart,
Sift me and convict me
I’ll teach you to the world,
Hallelujah, great Spirit in your giving is my birth,
Hallelujah, great Spirit in your giving is my life.

hymns.title: Hard Fightin' Soldier
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
CHORUS
Lord, I’m a hard fightin’ soldier on the battlefield (3x)
Yes I’m bringing souls to Jesus, by the service that I yield

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I’ve got a helmet on my head and in my hand a sword and shield  (3x)
And I’ll be bringin’ souls to Jesus, by the service that I yield

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I’ve got a message of good news for the sinful and the sad (3x)
And I’ll be bringin’ souls to Jesus by the service that I yield.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
You’ve got to walk right and talk right
And sing right and pray right on the battlefield (3x)
And I’ll be bringin’ souls to Jesus by the service that I yield.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Jesus is my captain and He fights my battles still,
He has never lost a battle and I know he never will,
I’ve got word for my sword and faith for my shield,
And I’ll be bringin’ souls to Jesus by the service that I yield.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
When I die, let me die in the service of the Lord ... (3x)
And I’ll be bringin’ souls to Jesus
By the service that I yield.

hymns.title: Hark! the Herald
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Hark! the herald angels sing
Glory to the new-born King,
Peace on earth, and mercy mild,
God and sinners reconciled.
Joyful, all ye nations, rise
Join the triumph of the skies;
With the angelic host proclaim,
Christ is born in Bethlehem.’

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Hark! the herald-angels sing
Glory to the new-born King.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Christ, by highest heaven adored,
Christ, the everlasting Lord,
Late in time behold Him come,
Offspring of a Virgin’s womb.
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see!
Hail, the incarnate Deity!
Pleased as man with man to dwell,
Jesus, our Emmanuel.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Hail, the heaven-born Prince of peace!
Hail the Sun of Righteousness!
Light and life to all He brings,
Risen with healing in His wings.
Mild He lays His glory by,
Born that man no more may die,
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth.

hymns.title: Have Thine Own Way
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Have Thine own way Lord
Have Thine own way,
Thou art the Porter
I am the clay
Mould me and make me
After Thy will
While I am waiting.
Yielded and still.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Have Thine own way, Lord
Have Thine own way,
Search me and try me
Master today
Whiter than snow, Lord
Wash me just now
As in Thy presence
Humbly I bow

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Have Thine own way, Lord
Have Thine own way,
Wounded and weary
Help me I pray
Power, all power
Surely is Thine
Touch me and heal me.
Saviour divine!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Have Thine own way Lord
Have Thine own way,
Hold o’er my being
Absolute sway
Fill with Thy spirit
Till all shall see
Christ only, always
Living in me.

hymns.title: Have You to Been to Jesus
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Have you been to Jesus, for the cleansing power
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you fully trusting in His grace this hour?
Are you washed in the blood

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Are you washed in the blood
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb:
Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Are you walking daily by the saviours’ side
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in the crucified
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
When the Bridegroom cometh will your robe be white,
Pure and white in the blood of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready, for the mansions bright
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb?

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Lay aside the garments that are stained with sin.
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb
There’s a fountain flowing for the soul unclean:
O be washed in the blood of the Lamb.

hymns.title: He Gave Her Water
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
CHORUS
Well, Jesus (He gave her water)
He gave her water, (He gave her water)
Oh, my Jesus (He gave her water)
Gave her water,(He gave her water)
Oh Jesus (He gave her water)
Gave her water (He gave her water)

sections.text:

She came to the well to get some water.
Oh, and there, she met a stranger
And He did her story tell.
She met my saviour bringing,
She came back to Him singing,
For the Man that gave her water, Lord

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Well on that woman, He had pity,
As she ran back to the city,
Shouting glory, hallelujah!
I’m gonna let it praise His way
Every time she doubted,
She stopped to think about Him;
‘Bout the man who gave her water, Lord

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Oh, gave her water, Jesus gave her water.
Oh, Jesus gave her water,
I’m gonna let it praise His way.
Jesus gave that woman water;
He gave that living lasting water.
Water, and it was not from the well.

hymns.title: He Is My Everything
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Some folks may ask me, some folks may say,
“Who is this Jesus, you talk about everyday?
He is my saviour, He set me free,
Now listen while I tell you, what He means to me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
He is my everything, He is my all.
He is my everything, both great and small.

hymns.title: He Paid a Debt He Did Not Owe
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
He paid a debt He did not owe
I owed a debt I could not pay
I needed someone
To wash my sins away.
And now I sing a brand new song,
“Amazing grace!”
Christ Jesus paid a debt
That I could never pay.

hymns.title: Heavenly Sunlight
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Walking in sunlight, all of my journey;
Over the mountains, thro’ the deep vale,
Jesus has said, “I’ll never forsake Thee.”
Promise divine that never can fail.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Heavenly sunlight, heavenly sunlight,
Flooding my soul with glory divine,
Hallelujah! I am rejoicing,
Singing His praises, Jesus is mine.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Shadows around me, shadows above me,
Never conceal my Saviour and Guide:
He is the light, in Him is no darkness,
Ever I’m walking close to his side.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
In the bright sunlight, ever rejoicing,
Pressing my way to mansion above;
Singing his praises, gladly I’m walking,
Walking in sunlight, sunlight of love.

hymns.title: Holy Father
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text: Holy Father, grant us peace (x2)

hymns.title: Holy, Holy, Holy!
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty
Early in the morning
Our song shall rise to Thee
Holy, holy, holy! merciful and mighty
God over all, and blest eternally.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Holy, holy, holy! all  the saints adore Thee
Casting down their golden crowns
Around the crystal sea;
Cherubim and Seraphim falling down before Thee,
Who wast, and art, and ever more shalt be.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Holy, holy, holy! tho’ the darkness hides Thee,
Tho’ the eye of sinful man
Thy glory may not see;
Only Thou art holy! There is none beside Thee,
Perfect in pow’r, in love, and purity.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
All Thy works shall praise Thy name,
In earth and sky, and sea,
Holy, holy, holy! merciful and mighty!
God over all, and blest eternally.

hymns.title: How Great Thou Art
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O  Lord my God!
When I in awesome wonder
Consider all the world Thy hands have made
I see the stars, I hear the rolling thunder
Thy pow’r throughout the universe displayed

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Then sings my soul my Saviour God to Thee:
How great Thou art: how great Thou art!
Then sings my soul my Saviour God to Thee:
How great Thou art; how great Thou art

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
When through the woods and forest glades I wonder
And hear the birds sing sweetly in the trees
When I look down from lofty mountain grandeur
And hear the brooks and feel the gentle breeze

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
And when I think that God His Son not sparing
Sent Him to die, I scarce can take it in
That on the cross my burden  gladly bearing.
He bled and died to take away my sin:

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
When Christ shall come with shouts of acclamation
And take me home, what joy shall fill my heart,
Then I shall bow in humble adoration
And there proclaim my God How great  Thou art.

hymns.title: How Majestic Is Your Name
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth
O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth.
O Lord, we praise Your name.
O Lord, we magnify Your name:
Prince of peace, mighty God;
O Lord God Almighty.

hymns.title: How Sweet, How Heavenly
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
How sweet, how heav'nly, is the sight,
When those that love the Lord
In one another's peace delight
And so fulfil the word

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
When each can feel his brother's sigh,
And with him bear apart;
When sorrow flows from eye to eye,
And joy from heart to heat

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
When , free from envy, scorn, and pride'
Our wishes all above,
Each can his brother's failing hide,
And show a brother's love

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
When love in one delightful stream
Thro' every bosom flows;
When union sweet and dear esteem
In every action glows

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Love is the golden chain that binds
The happy souls above:
And he's an heir of heav'n who finds
His bosom glow with love

hymns.title: Humble Yourself
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Humble yourself in the sight of the Lord (2x)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Amazing grace how sweet the sound (2x)
That saved a wretch like me.(2x)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I once was lost but now am found. (2x)

We’ve no less days to sing God’s praise. (2x)

hymns.title: I Am Not Afraid
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.text:

I am not afraid of ten-thousands of people,
Who have set themselves against Thee.
(Arise! Arise! Deliver me, O God!)

hymns.title: I Am Resolved
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I am resolved no longer to linger,
Charmed by the world’s delight;
Things that are higher, things that are nobler,
These have allured my sight.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
I will hasten to Him, (I will hasten, hasten to him),
Hasten so glad and free, (hasten glad and free),
Jesus, (Jesus, Jesus) greatest, highest I will come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I am resolved to go to the Saviour,
Leaving my sin and strife;
He is the true one, he is the just one,
He hath the words of life.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I am resolved to follow the Saviour,
Faithful and true each day,
Heed what He sayeth, do what He willeth,
He is the living way.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
I am resolved to enter the Kingdom
Leaving the paths of sin;
Friends may oppose me, foes may beset me,
Still will I enter in.

hymns.title: I Couldn't Keep It to Myself
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I said I wasn’t gonna talk about it
But I couldn’t keep it to myself,
No I couldn’t keep it to myself,
No I couldn’t keep it to myself.
Said I wasn’t gonna talk about it

What the Lord has done for me, for me.

You oughta been there, (you oughta been there)

What the Lord has done for me, for me.

hymns.title: I Feel Good
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.text:
I feel good, good, good.

I know there's something 'bout the Spirit of Jesus
That  makes me feel good, good, good

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I feel fine...
I feel nice...
I feel love...
I feel joy...
I feel peace...

hymns.title: I Have a Father That Will Never Fails
I Have Decided
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I have decided to follow Jesus (x3)
No turning back, no turning back.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Tho’ none go with me, still I will follow (x2)
No turning  back, no turning back.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
My cross I’ll carry ‘till I see Jesus, (x2)
No turning back, no turning back.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
The cross before me, the world behind me (2x)
No Turning back, no turning back.

hymns.title: I Have Seen the Lord's Goodness
I Hear God Singing to Me
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I hear God singing to me
Every Nation must be saved

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I hear God singing to me
Every challenge must be braved

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I feel God’s spirit in me
Quench it not, too much at stake
I hear God sing for Jesus’ sake (2x)

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text: I hear God singing to me (2x)

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
I hear God singing and rejoicing
And I love My Father’s song
I hear God singing and He’s saying
Everyone should sing along
Righteous singing scares the devil
So let’s shout our anthems loud
A soldier’s choir in holy concert
Voices lifted, faces bowed

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text: I hear God singing to me (2x)

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.text:
Gather as we start our movement
Scatter us, we scatter seeds
Planting Christ in every nation
As our great Crusade succeeds
Criticise us we grow stronger
Kill us and for sure we win
For our battle isn’t earthly
And our souls will never end

sections.label: Verse 8
sections.text: I hear God singing (2x)

sections.label: Verse 9
sections.text:
Sikiya Mungu a ki Yimba
Anurum Chukwu burum abu
Mo gbo Oluwa nkorin simi
J’entend mon Dieu qui me chant

hymns.title: I Just Want to Be Where You Are
I Know That My Redeemer Lives
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I know (I Know) that my redeemer lives,
And ever prays (and ever prays) for me;
I know (I know) eternal life He gives,
From sin and sorrow free.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
I know, I know that my redeemer lives,
I know, I know eternal life He gives;
I know, I know that my redeemer lives.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
He wills (He wills) that I should holy be,
In word, in tho’t (In word, in tho’t,) and deed;
Then I (then I) His holy face may see,
When from this earth-life freed.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I know (I know) that unto sinful men
His saving grace (His saving grace) is nigh;
I know (I know) that He will come again
To take me home on high.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
I know (I know) that over yonder stands
A place prepared (a place prepared) for me;
A home, ( a home) a house not made with hands,
Most wonderful to see.

hymns.title: I Know That My Redeemer Lives
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I know that my Redeemer lives,
And ever prays for me;
A token of His love He gives,
A pledge of liberty

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.text:
He will that I should holy be:
Can I withstand His will?
The counsel of His grace in me,
He surely shall fulfil.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Jesus, I hung upon Thy word,
I steadfastly believe
Thou wilt return and claim me, Lord,
And to Thy self receive.

hymns.title: I Love Thy Kingdom, Lord
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I love Thy kingdom, Lord,
The house of Thine abode,
The Church of our blest Redeemer saved
With his own precious blood.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I love Thy Church, O God!
Her walls before Thee stand
Dear as the apple of Thine eye,
And graven on Thy hand.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
For her my tears shall fall,
For her my prayers ascend,
To her my cares and toils be given,
Till toils and cares shall end.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Beyond my highest joy
I prize her heavenly ways,
Her sweet communion, solemn vows,
Her hymns of love and praise.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Sure as the truth shall last,
To Zion shall be given
The brightest glories can yield,
And brighter bliss of heaven.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text: Amen

hymns.title: I Love to Praise Him
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:

I love to Praise His name (2x)

sections.label: Verse 5

hymns.title: I Love to Tell the Story
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I love to tell the story
Of  unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
I love to tell the story,
Because I know 'tis true;
It satisfies my longings
As nothing else can do.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
I love to tell the story;
More wonderful it seems
Than all the golden fancies
Of all our golden dreams.
I love to tell the story,
It did so much for me;
And that is the reason
I tell it now to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I love to tell the story;
'Tis pleasant to repeat
What seems, each time I tell it,
More wonderfully sweet.
I love to tell the story,
For some have never heard
The message of salvation
From God's holy Word.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I love to tell the story,
For those who know it best
Seem hungering and thirsting
To hear it like the rest.
And when in the scenes of glory,
I sing the new, new song,
'Twill be the old, old story
That I have loved so long.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and his love.
Amen

hymns.title: I Need Thee Every Hour
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I need Thee ev’ry hour,
Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice like Thine
Can peace afford.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
I need Thee, O I need Thee,
Ev’ry hour I need Thee!
O bless me now my saviour:
I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I need Thee ev’ry hour:
Stay Thou near by:
Temptations lose their pow’r
When Thou art nigh.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I need Thee ev’ry hour,
In joy or pain;
Come quickly and abide,
Or life is vain.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
I need Thee ev’ry hour,
Most Holy One;
O make me Thine indeed,
Thou blessed Son!

hymns.title: I Tried and I Tried
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I tried and I tried,  I tried and I tried, (Hallelujah),
I tried and I tried, until I found the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2

CHORUS
My soul (just couldn’t be contented)
My soul (just couldn’t be contented)
My soul (just couldn’t be content)
Until I found the Lord

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I searched and I searched....
I prayed and I prayed...

hymns.title: I Want Jesus to Walk with Me

Verse 2

sections.label: Verse 4

hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.text:

Who is worthy to be praised
So shall I be saved from my enemies

The Lord liveth

Let us praise  the Lord of lords

Praise the Father, Son and the Spirit.

hymns.title: I Will Enter to His Gate
I Will Lift Up Jesus Higher
I Will Speak
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I will speak softly of the Lord,
Whom I confess as mine;
His promises are wonderful,
My saviour is divine.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Will He say, “Well done, well done,”
Will He say this to me?
Will He say, “Well done, well done,
Good faithful servant, well done.”?

sections.text:
I will speak firmly of the Lord,

By His example of living well,
I see that I am free.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I will speak boldly of the Lord,

hymns.title: I'll Be a Friend to Jesus
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
They tried my Lord and Master
With no one to defend;
Within the halls of Pilate
He stood without a friend

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
I’ll be a friend to Jesus,

I’ll be a friend to Jesus,

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
The world may turn against Him,
I’ll love Him to the end;
And while on earth I’m living,
My Lord shall have a friend.

sections.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.text:
To all who need a Saviour,
My friend I recommend,
Because He brought salvation,
Is why I am His friend.

hymns.title: I'll Fly Away
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:

I'll (fly away) Fly away, (Fly away)

sections.text:

I'll (fly away) Fly away, (Fly away)

hymns.title: I'm Not Ashamed to Own My Lord
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I’m not ashamed to own my Lord,
Nor to defend His cause;
Maintain the honour of His word,
The glory of His cross.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Firm as His throne His promise stands,

What I’ve committed to His hands,
Till the decisive hour.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:

hymns.title: Ihe Nile Nwere Nuwa Digi Naka

sections.text:

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:

hymns.title: In the Kingdom

Verse 3
sections.text:

sections.text:

sections.label: Verse 5

Sharing, singing, yes I am.

hymns.title: It Is a Good Thing to Serve the Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:

When sorrows like sea billows roll;
Whatever my lot, Thou has taught me to say,
“It is well, it is well with my soul.”

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
It is well (it is well)
With my soul ( with my soul),
It is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
My sin O the bliss of this glorious tho’t

O Lamb of God, I come! I come!

sections.label: Verse 5

O Lamb of God, I come! I come!

hymns.title: Nearer, Still Nearer
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Nearer, still nearer, close to Thy heart,
Draw me, my saviour, so precious Thou art;
Fold me, O fold me close to Thy breast,
Shelter me safe in that haven of rest,
Shelter me safe in that haven of rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Nearer still nearer, nothing I bring,
Naught as an offering to Jesus my King,
Only my sinful, now contrite heart;
Grant me the cleansing Thy blood doth impart,
Grant me the cleansing Thy blood doth impart.

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.text:
Nearer, Still, nearer, while life shall last,
‘Till safe in glory my anchor is cast;
Thro’ endless ages, ever to be,
Nearer, my saviour, still nearer to Thee,
Nearer, my saviour, still nearer to Thee.

hymns.title: No Tears in Heaven
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
No tears in heaven, no sorrow given,
All will be glory in the Land;
There'll be no sadness, all will be gladness,
When we shall join the happy band.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Chorus
No tears, (In heaven fair,)
No tears, no tears up there,
Sorrow and pain will all have flown;
No tears, (In heaven fair,)
No tears, no tears up there,
No tears in heaven will be known.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Glory is waiting, waiting up yonder,
Where we shall spend an endless day;
There with our saviour, we'll be forever,
Where no more sorrow can dismay.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Some morning yonder, we'll cease to ponder
O'er things this life has bro't to view;
All will be clearer, saved ones be dearer,
In heav'n where all will be made new.

The only God

sections.text:
O come, all ye faithful
Joyful and triumphant,
O Come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem;
Come and behold Him
Born, the King of angels;
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
God of God
Light of Light,
Lo, He abhors not the virgin’s womb
Very, God
Begotten, not created;
O come, let us adore Him,

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Sing, choirs of angels,
Sing in exultation,
Sing, all ye citizens of heaven above:
Glory to God
In the highest:
O come, let us adore Him,

sections.label: Verse 4

Ye, Lord, we greet Thee,
Born this happy morning
Jesus, to Thee be glory given;
Word of the Father,
Now in flesh appearing:
O come, let us adore Him,

hymns.title: O Come, O Come Emmanuel
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O come, o come Emmanuel
And ransom captive Israel
That mourns in lonely exile here
Until the son of God appear.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, o Israel!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
O come, Thou wisdom from on high
And order all things far and nigh.
To us the path of  knowledge show;
And cause us in Thy way to go.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
O come , Desire of nations bind
All peoples in one heat and mind,
Bid envy, strife and quarrels cease;
Fill the whole world with heaven's peace.

hymns.title: O Little Town
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O Little town of Bethlehem,
How still we see Thee lie!
Above Thy deep and dreamless sleep
The silent stars go by:
Yet in Thy dark streets shineth
The everlasting Light
The hopes and fears of all the years
Are met in Thee to-night

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
For Christ is born of Mary;
And, gathered all above,
While mortals sleep, the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.
O morning stars, together
Proclaim the holy birth,
And praises sing to God the King
And peace to men on earth.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
How silently, how silently,
The wondrous gift is given!
So God imparts to human hearts
The blessings of His heaven
No ear may hear His coming;
But in this world of sin,
Where meek souls will receive Him,
The dear Christ enters in.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
O holy Child of Bethlehem,
Descend to us, we pray
Cast out our sin, and enter in:
Be born in us to-day.
We hear the Christmas angels
The great glad tidings tell:
O come to us, abide with us,
Our Lord Immanuel.

sections.text:
O Lord, our Lord,
How excellent Thy name;
How excellent is Thy name

hymns.title: O Master, Let Me Walk with Thee
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O Master, let me walk with Thee
In lowly paths of service free;
Tell me Thy secret, help me bear
The stain of toil, the fret of care.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Help me the slow of heart to move
By some clear, winning word of love;
Teach me the wayward feet to stay,
And guide them in the homeward way

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
In hope that sends a shining ray
Far down the future's broad'ning way,
In peace that only thou canst give,
With Thee, O Master let me live.

hymns.title: O Perfect Love
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O perfect Love, all human thought transcending,
Lowly we kneel in prayer before Thy throne,
that theirs may be the love which knows no ending,
Whom Thou forever more dost join in one.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
O perfect Life, be Thou their full assurance,
Of tender charity and steadfast faith,
Of patient hope and quiet, brave endurance,
With child-like trust that fears nor pain nor death.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Grant them the joy which brightens earthly sorrow;
Grant them the peace which clams all earthly strife,
And to life’s day the glorious unknown morrow
That dawns up on eternal love life.
Amen.

hymns.title: O Praise the Lord

O praise the Lord, praise him all ye people,
For his merciful kindness is great tow’rd us, is great tow’rd us;
And the truth of the Lord endureth for ever,
for ever and ever, ever and ever
Praise ye the Lord.

hymns.title: O Sacred Head Now Wounded
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O sacred head, now wounded,
With grief and shame weighed down;
Now scornfully surrounded
With thorns Thine only crown;
How art Thou pale with anguish,
With sore abuse and scorn
How doth that visage languish
Which once was bright as morn!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
What language shall I borrow,
To thank Thee dearest friend,
For this Thy dying sorrow,
Thy pity without end?
O make me Thine forever;
And should I fainting be,
Lord let me never, never
Out live my love for Thee.

hymns.title: O Worship the King
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
O  worship the King all glorious above.
And gratefully sing His wonderful love:
Our Shield and Defender, the ancient of days,
Pavilioned in splendour and girded with praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Thy bountiful care what tongues can recite?
It breathes in the air, it shines in the light:
It streams from the hills, it descends to the plain
And sweetly distils in the dew and the rain.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Frail children of dust and feeble as frail
In Thee do we trust nor find Thee to fail
Thy mercies how tender how firm to the end
Our Maker, Defender, Redeemer, and Friend!
