hymns.title: Ole Ebe Iga Ala Ma Inwuo
On a Hill Far Away
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
On a hill far away stood an old rugged cross,
The emblem of suff’ring and shame;
And I love that old cross where the dearest and best
For a world of lost sinners was slain.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
So I’ll cherish the old rugged cross,
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
O that old rugged cross, so despised by the world,
Has a wondrous attraction for me;
For the dear Lamb of God left His glory above,
To bear it to dark Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
In that old rugged cross, stained with blood so divine,
A wondrous beauty I see;
For ’twas on that old cross Jesus suffered and died,
To pardon and sanctify me.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
To the old rugged cross I will ever be true,
Its shame and reproach gladly bear;
Then He’ll call me some day to my home far away,
Where His glory for ever I’ll share.

hymns.title: On Zion's Glorious Summit
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
On Zion’s glorious summit stood
A num’rous host redeemed by blood!
They hymned their King in strains divine,
I heard the song and strove to join (x2)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Holy, holy, holy Lord
God of hosts, on high adored!
Who like me Thy praise should sing,
O Almighty King! Holy, holy, holy.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Here all who suffered sword or flame
For truth, or Jesus’ lovely name,
Shout victory now and hail the Lamb,
And bow before the great I AM. (X2)

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
While everlasting ages roll,
Eternal love shall feast their soul,
And scenes of bliss, for ever new,
Rise in succession to their view. (X2)

hymns.title: One and Only
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
(Unison)
In the beginning was the Word,
He was Incarnate in our Lord,
He was with God
And He was with God
In Him was Light and life of men
Darkness dies as He comes to reign
We shall see it
We have seen it
Hallelujah!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
(Two part round)
True Light enlightens every man
Shining in Jesus is God’s plan
And He made us
And He saves us
But man He made He made received Him not
Yet scene believed the son of God.
He will save them
We Will save them.
Hallelujah!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
(Three Part Round)
Now He comes into His own home
Building His house, the Living stone
We receive Him
We believe Him
Power He gives to those New Born
Born not of man but born of God
He’s our “Abba”
He’s our “Father”
Hallelujah!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
(Unison)
Word in the flesh has come to dwell
Walking on earth to know us well
Giving full grace.
Giving full truth.
We have beheld His great Glory
The Bible shows us His story;
“ONE AND ONLY, FROM THE FATHER”
Hallelujah!
Amen!

hymns.title: Onward Christian Soldiers
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Onward, Christian Soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus going on before:
Christ the royal Master,
Leads against the foe:
Forward into battle,
See His banners go!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Onward Christian Soldiers
Marching as to war
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
At the sign of triumph
Satan’s host doth flee:
On then Christian soldiers
On to victory:
Hell’s foundation quiver
At the shout of praise:
Brothers lift your voices,
Loud your anthems raise!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Crowns and thrones may perish,
Kingdoms rise and wane,
But the church of Jesus
Constant will remain:
Gates of hell can never
‘Gainst that church prevail:
We have Christ’s own promise.
And that cannot fail.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Onward, then ye people,
Join our happy throng:
Blend with ours your voices
In the triumph song:
Glory, Laud and honour
Unto Christ the King.
This thro’ countless ages
Men and angels sing.

hymns.title: Oti Se O Baba Ti Se O
Our God, He Is Alive
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
There is beyond the azure blue,
A God concealed from human sight
He tinted skies with heavenly hue,
And framed the world with His great
might.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
There is a God, (There is a God)
He is alive, (He is alive)
In Him we live, (In Him we live)
And we survive, (And we survive)
From dust our God, (From dust our God)
Created man, (Created man)
He is our God, (He is our God)
The Great I AM (The Great I AM).

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
There was a long, long time ago
A God whose voice the prophets heard.
He is the God that we should know
Who speaks from His inspired word.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Secure is life from mortal's mind
God holds the germ within His hand
Though men may search they cannot find
For God alone does understand.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Our God whose Son upon the tree,
A life was willing there to give,
That He from sin might set men free,
And ever more with him could live.

hymns.title: Peace, Perfect Peace
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin:
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Peace, perfect peace, by thoning duties pressed
To do the will of Jesus this is rest

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round:
On Jesus' bosom naught but calm is found.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away:
In Jesus' keeping we are safe, and they.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
Peace, perfect peace, Our future all unknown:
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
It is enough; earth's struggles soon shall cease,
And Jesus call us to heav'n's perfect peace.

hymns.title: Pilgrim Song
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
He who would valiant be
‘Gainst all disaster,
Let him in for constancy
Follow the master,
There’s no discouragement
Shall make him once relent,
His first arrowed intent,
To be a pilgrim.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Who as beset him round,
With dismal stories,
Do but themselves confound,
His strength the more is
No foes shall stay his might’
Though he with giants fight:
He will make his right,
To be a pilgrim.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Since, Lord Thou dost defend
Us with Thy spirit,
We know we at the end,
Shall life inherit,
Then fancies flee away!
I’ll fear not what men say,
To be a pilgrim.

hymns.title: Poor, Wayfaring Stranger
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I am a poor, wayfaring stranger
While trav’lling through this world of woe,
Yet there’s no sickness, toil nor danger
In that bright world to which I go.
I’m going there to see my Father,
I’m going there no more to roam;
I’m only going over Jordan,
I’m only going over home.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.text:
I’ll soon be free from ev’ry trial’
My body sleep in the church-yard;
I’ll drop the cross of self denial
And enter on my great reward.
I’m going there to see my Saviour,
To sing His praise for ever more;
I’m only going over Jordan,
I’m only going over home.

To our fathers in distress

Slow to chide and swift  to bless
Praise Him! Praise Him (2x)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:

Praise Him Praise Him!
Widely as His mercy flows.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Angels help us to adore Him
Ye behold Him face to face
Sun and moon, bow down before Him
Dwellers all in time and space!
Praise Him! Praise Him (2x)
Praise with us the God of grace.

hymns.title: Praise the Lord
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.text:
Praise the Lord, for He is glorious;
Never shall His promise fail,
God hath made His saints victorious:
Sin and death shall not prevail.

sections.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.text:
Sun and moon  rejoice before Him,
Praise Him all ye stars of light.
Hallelujah! Amen, Hallelujah! Amen,
Amen, Amen.

hymns.title: Praise to the Lord, The Almighty
Prayer for Boldness
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Father God whom we seek first,
With a cross You killed a curse,
And from a grave death You destroyed,
And now to preach we are employed.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Opposing us You know the horde
Who retreat when we say, “Lord!”
Violence, lies, discord and shame:
Satan hates and breeds the same.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
CHORUS
Why are all the nations raging,
Making our world cold?
We’ll SHOUT! louder than the Devil,
Lord make us all bold!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Yet men scheme for all their worth
Fighting our campaign for earth;
Destroy our fear of those who kill,
You know their threats
we know your will.
Consider now all threats and hate:
With love we retaliate;
Flood our veins with zeal for you.
God make many from a few .

sections.label: Verse 5
Verse 6
sections.text:
(Demon’s reign is cold,
Warm the world as told,
Satan in His hold,
Shake the world, make us bold!)

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.text:
Why are all the nations raging,
Making our world cold?
We’ll SHOUT! louder than the Devil,
Lord, make us all bold!
Make us bold!

hymns.title: Psalm 61
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Hear my cry O Lord, listen to my prayer
From the ends of the Earth,
I will call unto you.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
And if my heart is overwhelmed
Lead me to the Rock that is higher than I.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text: That is higher than I.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
For you have been a refuge unto me
And a strong tower from the enemy.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
I long to dwell forever in your tent
Shelter I will take underneath your wings.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.text:
For you have heard my vows to you O God
And the Fear of your Name is my heritage.

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.text:
Then will I ever sing praise to your Name
And fulfil my vows tomorrow and today.

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS

Merrily ring, speed it away
Message divine, send it today;

Darkness and doubt;

Making men free, happy and free,
Ring, ring, ring, ring,
Ring the message out.

sections.label: Verse 3

To all the lost of ev’ry nation,
Ring it out

sections.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.text:
Sin and doubt to sweep away,

hymns.title: Rise Up, O Men of God
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Rise up, O men of God!
Have done with lesser things;
Give heart and mind and soul and strength
To serve the Kings of kings.
Rise up, O men of God!
His Kingdom tarries long:
Bring in the day of brotherhood
And end the night of wrong.

sections.text:
Rise up, O men of God!
The church for you doth wait,
Her strength unequal to her task;
Rise up and make her great!

Lift high the cross of Christ!
Tread where His feet have trod;

hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.text:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,

Let the water and the blood,
From Thy riven side which flowed,

sections.text:
Not the labour of my hands
Can fulfil Thy law’s demands;
Could my zeal no respite know,

sections.text:

Hallelu, Hallelujah.

sections.label: Verse 5

hymns.title: Send the Light
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
There’s a call comes ringing o’er the restless waves,
Send the light, send the light.
There are souls to rescue, there are souls to save,
Send the light, send the light.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
Send the light, the blessed gospel light,

Send the light, the blessed gospel light,

sections.text:
We have heard the Macedonian call today,

Send the light, send the light.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:

Send the light, send the light.

hymns.title: Shall We Gather at the River?
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Shall we gather at the river,
Where bright angel feet have trod
With its Crystal tide forever
Flowing by the throne of God

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Chorus
Oh yes, we'll gather at the river
The beautiful the beautiful river,
Gather with the saints at the river,
That flows by the throne of God.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
On the Margin of the river,
Washing up it's silver spray,
We will walk and worship ever
All the happy, golden day.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Ere we reach the shining river,
Lay we every burden down;
Grace our spirit will deliver,
And provide a robe and crown

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.text:
At he smiling of the river,
Minor of them Saviour's face,
Saints whom death will never sever
Left their songs of saving grace.

hymns.title: Soldiers of Christ, Arise!
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Soldiers of Christ, arise

Strong in the Lord of hosts

Who in the strength of Jesus trusts,

That having all things done,

hymns.title: Spirit of the Living God
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,

Standing on the promises of God.

Standing on the promises I cannot fall,

hymns.title: Victory in Jesus
hymns.creditLine: Author unknown. Public domain. Source: Hymnary.org.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
I heard an old, old story,
How a Saviour came from glory
How He gave His life on Calvary
To save a wretch like me;
I heard about His groaning
Of His precious blood atoning,
Then I repented of my sins and won the victory.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
CHORUS
O victory in Jesus, my Saviour, forever,
He sought me and bought me
With His redeeming blood;
He loved me ere I knew Him
And all my love is due Him,
He plunged me to victory
Beneath the cleansing flood.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
I heard about His healing,
Of His cleansing pow’r revealing,
How He made the lame to walk again
And caused the blind to see;
And then I cried “Dear Jesus,
Come and heal my broken spirit”
I then obeyed His blest commands
And gained the victory.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
I heard about a mansion
He has built for me in glory
And I heard about the street of gold
Beyond the crystal sea;
About the angels singing,
And the old redemption story,
And some sweet day
I’ll sing up there and song of victory.
